#Nadaraya-Waston核回归
设定核函数K，带宽h_n>0
定义加权平均核
$$
w_i(x)=\frac{K_{h_n}(X_i-x)}{\sum_{j=1}^nK_{h_n}(X_j-x)}
$$
核回归定义为
$$
\hat{m}_n(x)=\sum_{i=1}^nw_i(x)Y_i
$$
注意到
$$
\hat{\theta}=min\sum_{i=1}^nw_i(x)(Y_i-\theta)^2
$$
核函数列表
```{r}
kernel_list <- list(

  uniform = function(u) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, 0.5, 0)
  },

  triangle = function(u) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, 1 - abs(u), 0)
  },

  epanechnikov = function(u) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, 3/4 * (1 - u^2), 0)
  },

  quartic = function(u) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, 15/16 * (1 - u^2)^2, 0)
  },

  triweight = function(u) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, 35/32 * (1 - u^2)^3, 0)
  },

  gaussian = function(u) {
    dnorm(u)
  },

  cosine = function(u) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, pi/4 * cos(pi * u / 2), 0)
  },

  exponential = function(u) {
    0.5 * exp(-abs(u))
  }
)

kde_general <- function(x0, data, h, kernel) {
  mean(kernel((x0 - data) / h)) / h
}
```


```{r}
nw_regression_point <- function(x, X, Y, h, kernel) {
  # 核权重（未归一化）
  K_vals <- kernel((X - x) / h) / h
  
  # 防止分母为 0
  if (sum(K_vals) == 0) {
    return(NA)
  }
  
  # 归一化权重
  w <- K_vals / sum(K_vals)
  
  # 核回归估计
  sum(w * Y)
}

nw_regression <- function(x_grid, X, Y, h, kernel) {
  sapply(x_grid, function(x) {
    nw_regression_point(x, X, Y, h, kernel)
  })
}

set.seed(123)

n <- 100
X <- sort(runif(n, 0, 1))
Y <- sin(2 * pi * X) + rnorm(n, sd = 0.2)

x_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)

m_hat <- nw_regression(
  x_grid,
  X,
  Y,
  h = 0.08,
  kernel = kernel_list$gaussian
)

plot(X, Y, pch = 16, col = "gray")
lines(x_grid, m_hat, col = "red", lwd = 2)

```



#Gauss-Muller核回归

$$
s_i=\frac{x_i+x_{i+1}{2}
$$
$$
\hat{m}(x)=\sum_{i=1}^n\int_{s_{i-1}}^{s_i}K(\frac{u-x}{h})du y_i
$$

```{r}
#单点Gauss-Muller核回归
gm_regression_point <- function(x, X, Y, h, kernel) {
  n <- length(X)
  
  # 构造 s_i
  s <- numeric(n + 1)
  s[2:n] <- (X[1:(n - 1)] + X[2:n]) / 2
  
  # 边界处理
  s[1] <- X[1] - (X[2] - X[1]) / 2
  s[n + 1] <- X[n] + (X[n] - X[n - 1]) / 2
  
  weights <- numeric(n)
  
  for (i in 1:n) {
    integrand <- function(u) {
      kernel((u - x) / h)
    }
    
    weights[i] <- integrate(
      integrand,
      lower = s[i],
      upper = s[i + 1]
    )$value
  }
  
  sum(weights * Y)
}

#向量化版本，可以输入多个x
gm_regression <- function(x_grid, X, Y, h, kernel) {
  sapply(x_grid, function(x) {
    gm_regression_point(x, X, Y, h, kernel)
  })
}

set.seed(123)

n <- 100
X <- sort(runif(n, 0, 1))
Y <- sin(2 * pi * X) + rnorm(n, sd = 0.2)

x_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)

m_hat_gm <- gm_regression(
  x_grid,
  X,
  Y,
  h = 0.08,
  kernel = kernel_list$gaussian
)

plot(X, Y, pch = 16, col = "gray",
     xlab = "x", ylab = "y",
     main = "Nadaraya–Watson vs Gauss–Muller")

lines(x_grid, m_hat, col = "red", lwd = 2)
lines(x_grid, m_hat_gm, col = "blue", lwd = 2)

legend("topright",
       legend = c("NW", "Gauss–Muller"),
       col = c("red", "blue"),
       lwd = 2)



```

#局部多项式回归

$$
\sum_{i=1}^n\{Y_i-a(x)-b(x)X_i\}^2K_{h_n}(X_i-x)
$$

$$
\hat{m}(x)=\hat{a}(x)+\hat{b}(x)X_i
$$

$$
\sum w_i(x)Y_i
$$

```{r}
local_linear_point <- function(x, X, Y, h, kernel) {
  u <- (X - x) / h
  K <- kernel(u) / h
  
  S0 <- sum(K)
  S1 <- sum(K * (X - x))
  S2 <- sum(K * (X - x)^2)
  
  T0 <- sum(K * Y)
  T1 <- sum(K * (X - x) * Y)
  
  # 截距 = m(x) 的估计
  (S2 * T0 - S1 * T1) / (S0 * S2 - S1^2)
}

local_linear <- function(x_grid, X, Y, h, kernel) {
  sapply(x_grid, function(x) {
    local_linear_point(x, X, Y, h, kernel)
  })
}

set.seed(123)

n <- 100
X <- sort(runif(n, 0, 1))
Y <- sin(2 * pi * X) + rnorm(n, sd = 0.2)

x_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)

m_ll <- local_linear(
  x_grid,
  X,
  Y,
  h = 0.08,
  kernel = kernel_list$gaussian
)

plot(X, Y, pch = 16, col = "gray")
lines(x_grid, m_ll, col = "blue", lwd = 2)

```

拓展到局部多项式回归

#LOWESS稳健回归

对模型进行局部线性回归，得到m(X_i)的估计$\hat{m}(X_i)$，得到残差$r_i=Y_i-\hat{m}(X_i)$

计算稳健权数$\delta_i=B(ri/6\cdot median(|r_1|,|r_2|,...,|r_n) $，其中$B(t)=(1-|t|^2)^2I_{[-1,1]}(t)$,I为指示函数

使用权$\delta_iK(h_n^{-1}(X_i-x))$对模型进行局部加权最小二乘估计，就可得到新的r_i

重复第二步第三步s次后就可得到LOWESS稳健回归
```{r}
bisquare_weight <- function(t) {
  w <- (1 - t^2)^2
  w[abs(t) > 1] <- 0
  w
}

robust_local_linear_point <- function(
  x, X, Y, h, kernel, delta
) {
  u <- (X - x) / h
  K <- kernel(u) / h
  
  # 总权重 = 稳健权 × 核权
  W <- delta * K
  
  S0 <- sum(W)
  S1 <- sum(W * (X - x))
  S2 <- sum(W * (X - x)^2)
  
  T0 <- sum(W * Y)
  T1 <- sum(W * (X - x) * Y)
  
  (S2 * T0 - S1 * T1) / (S0 * S2 - S1^2)
}

robust_lowess <- function(
  X, Y,
  x_grid,
  h,
  kernel,
  s = 3
) {
  n <- length(X)
  
  # Step 0: 初始局部线性回归
  m_hat <- sapply(X, function(xi) {
    local_linear_point(xi, X, Y, h, kernel)
  })
  
  r <- Y - m_hat
  
  for (iter in 1:s) {
    # Step 1: 计算稳健权
    scale <- 6 * median(abs(r))
    delta <- bisquare_weight(r / scale)
    
    # Step 2: 更新回归函数（在 X_i 上）
    m_hat <- sapply(X, function(xi) {
      robust_local_linear_point(
        xi, X, Y, h, kernel, delta
      )
    })
    
    r <- Y - m_hat
  }
  
  # 返回在 grid 上的估计
  m_grid <- sapply(x_grid, function(x) {
    robust_local_linear_point(
      x, X, Y, h, kernel, delta
    )
  })
  
  list(
    fitted = m_hat,
    residuals = r,
    m_grid = m_grid
  )
}

set.seed(123)

n <- 100
X <- sort(runif(n))
Y <- sin(2 * pi * X) + rnorm(n, 0, 0.2)

# 加几个离群点
Y[c(10, 30, 70)] <- Y[c(10, 30, 70)] + c(3, -3, 2)

x_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)

fit_robust <- robust_lowess(
  X, Y,
  x_grid,
  h = 0.08,
  kernel = kernel_list$gaussian,
  s = 3
)

plot(X, Y, pch = 16, col = "gray")
lines(x_grid, fit_robust$m_grid, col = "blue", lwd = 2)


```

#现有的包
默认迭代4次
```{r}
fit_loess <- loess(
  Y ~ X,
  span = 0.2,
  degree = 1,           # 局部线性
  family = "symmetric"  # 启用稳健权
)

m_hat_loess <- predict(fit_loess, newdata = data.frame(X = x_grid))

plot(X, Y, pch = 16, col = "gray")
lines(x_grid, m_hat_loess, col = "green", lwd = 2)

```
